item.title: 207-Mile 2022 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500
item.description: This 2022 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 was purchased new by the seller from North Country Ford of Jasper, Alabama, and now has 207 miles. It is powered by a supercharged 5.2-liter V8 linked with a Tremec seven-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission and a Torsen limited-slip differential. The car is finished in Oxford White over Ebony Dove leather. Features include HID headlights, 20" split-spoke alloy wheels, Brembo brakes, heated and cooled power-adjustable front seats, and SYNC 3 infotainment.

item.title: 1949 Chevrolet 3100 Pickup 4-Speed
item.description: This 1949 Chevrolet 3100 pickup is refinished in green over black vinyl and is powered by a 235ci inline-six paired with a four-speed manual transmission. The selling dealer tells us that a refurbishment was completed in 2023. Equipment includes 15" steel wheels with chrome hub caps, a front disc brake conversion, an aluminum radiator, and a wood-plank cargo bed floor. This 3100 pickup was acquired by the selling dealer in 2025 and is now offered with a clean Kansas title.

The car spent time in Texas and Oklahoma before being sold on BaT in September 2025, and the clutch was replaced in late 2025; the selling dealer acquired the vehicle in February 2026. item.description: This Ford GT was produced as a road car on August 17, 2016, and it is the second of two cars used by Ford Performance as a development mule for its track-only GT Mk II variant.
